title: Analysis code for: From functional definitions to linguistic features: a quantitative test of Reiss's text typology in Chinese

creators.name: Feng, Linjie
creators.affiliation: Jiangxi Science and Technology Normal University, Nanchang, China

creators.name: Deng, Yaye
creators.affiliation: Jiangxi Science and Technology Normal University, Nanchang, China

description: Reproduction code for the manuscript. Implements 13 theory-driven feature extraction (feature_extractor_v9_4), logistic-regression classification with stratified five-fold cross-validation, character- and word-level TF-IDF baselines, leave-one-group-out validation, ablation, and within-type factor analysis. Reference outputs are provided in outputs_reference/. The annotated corpus itself is not included for licensing reasons; a synthetic demo corpus (corpus/demo_corpus.json) is provided for smoke-testing.
